findings.detail: Backgrounding writes generic capture with no routeHandle. Initially suspected this would prevent current-pickup access. Actual placed-widget tap opened the intended pickup; do not report the initial hypothesis as a reproduced bug. Refresh-budget and stale-timeline variations remain outside this narrow runtime proof.

Projection permits only version/generation/writtenAt/opaque routeHandle/destination. Widget view always renders generic label. Source declares complete file protection and App Intent requiresAuthentication; simulator does not establish physical enforcement.

remaining_physical_device_checks: Install a team-signed app and extensions with matching registered App Groups on a passcode-protected iPhone.

Add Home Screen and supported Lock Screen widget families; use fictional pickup items, a spending cap, and private notes. Verify only generic content or protected placeholder before unlock, after lock, and after reboot before first unlock.
Tap widget and run Grocery entry in Shortcuts while locked; verify device authentication, no private display before authorization, and intended current pickup/review destination afterward.

Revoke or change household role/enrollment and re-open retained widget routes; confirm unavailable state until valid current authorization. Existing tests use local synthetic boundaries, not deployed revocation.
Repeat after selected pickup changes and across delayed WidgetKit timeline refresh; verify intended destination and no stale private disclosure.

recommended_fixes.product: None justified by a reproduced defect in this scope. Keep authentication and complete file-protection policies.
recommended_fixes.tests: Promote the bounded coordinator probe and separate system widget/Shortcuts acceptance cases if useful; keep real App Group checks off shared simulators and omit --ui-testing only on disposable installations.
